The `source` array points to a predictable tarball URL based on the package's own GitHub repository, and the checksum is provided, though even a missing or skipped checksum would not affect the safety of this specific command.

Thus, running `makepkg --printsrcinfo` on this PKGBUILD is safe, as it does not trigger any code execution beyond parsing static declarations.
</details>
